candidates.explanation: The confirmation link for a changed email is built with the '/confirm-email' frontend path, the same path userSignUp uses. The frontend page at that path calls the sign-up confirmation endpoint (auth/email/confirm), which expects a sign-up hash. The email-change flow needs the '/confirm-new-email' page, which calls auth/email/confirm/new. Because of this, the link opens the activation page and the email change is never completed.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email' so the link goes to the page that calls the confirmNewEmail endpoint.
